Your first patrol

Sink both merchant vessels and survive. Use the tactical chart to track the convoy and its escort.

W / S
Increase / decrease ordered speed
A / D
Hold to steer port / starboard
1 / 2 / 3
External / periscope / tactical chart

Fire a torpedo at the selected contact

P / H

Drag / scroll
Orbit or scan / zoom

A firing solution needs a range below 2,400 m, depth of 14 m or less, and speed of 8 knots or less. Turn within 40° of the target. The fire control officer calculates the lead. Torpedoes travel straight: close the range for a better shot.

After firing, dive and run silently to escape the escort. Surface to recharge. Patrol time and weapon travel are accelerated for a shorter mission.
